question: The average age of 32 students of a class is 21 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 22 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Teacher's Age = Old Average + (Total Members × Increase in Average)

Old Average = 21 years

Total Members (including teacher) = 32 + 1 = 33

Increase in Average = 22 − 21 = 1 year

Teacher's Age = 21 + (33 × 1) = 54

**∴ The correct answer is 54 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students = 32

Average age of 32 students = 21 years

New average age (including teacher) = 22 years

**Formula Used:**

Total Age = Average Age × Number of Persons

 Deviation Method Total Persons = 32 + 1 = 33 | Avg Increase = 22 − 21 = 1 Old Avg: 21 + Increase: 33 × 1 = 33 
 Teacher's Age = 21 + 33 = 54 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 32 students = 32 × 21

⇒ Total age of 32 students = 672 years

⇒ Total number of persons after including the teacher = 32 + 1 = 33

⇒ Total age of 33 persons = 33 × 22

⇒ Total age of 33 persons = 726 years

⇒ Age of the teacher = Total age of 33 persons − Total age of 32 students

⇒ Age of the teacher = 726 − 672 = 54 years

**∴ The correct answer is 54 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Net Deviation Method (Joining)

When a new member joins a group and the overall average increases, the new member brings their share of the old average plus the extra weight distributed to everyone.

New Value = Old Average + (New Total Persons × Increase in Average)

Net Deviation Method (Leaving)

If a member leaves a group and the average decreases, it means they took away more than the average value.

Left Value = Old Average + (Remaining Persons × Decrease in Average)

Replacement Method

If one person is replaced by another and the average changes, the number of people remains the same.

Value of New Person = Value of Replaced Person + (Total Persons × Change in Average)
